description: Read Hudu companies, assets, layouts and expirations and manage knowledge base articles.

hudu_new_article_trigger.description: Runs for each new article in Hudu. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, created_at, updated_at
